# `hex` standard library

The `hex` module provides RFC 4648 Section 8 Base16 (hexadecimal) encoding and
case-insensitive decoding with diagnostic column offsets on malformed input.

```{.dva .run}
#use hex
#use io

enc = hex::encode("Edva")
io::out $ enc
hex::decode(enc) | dec => io::out $ dec
```

## Function catalog

| Symbol / Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `hex::encode(s)` | `String => String` | Encodes raw bytes of `s` into lowercase hexadecimal (`2 * ?s` ASCII bytes) |
| `hex::encode_upper(s)` | `String => String` | Encodes raw bytes of `s` into uppercase hexadecimal (`2 * ?s` ASCII bytes) |
| `hex::decode(s)` | `String => < String | Error >` | Decodes a case-insensitive hexadecimal string into raw bytes, or returns an `Error` on odd length or non-hex bytes |
